name: MIMIC-CXR
description: A large, de-identified database of chest radiographs paired with free-text radiology reports from the Beth Israel Deaconess Medical Center. Access is credentialed through PhysioNet and requires completion of required training and acceptance of the applicable data use agreement; this record does not distribute dataset files.
citation: Johnson, A. E. W., Pollard, T. J., Greenbaum, N. R., Lungren, M. P., Deng, C.-Y., Peng, Y., Lu, Z., Mark, R. G., Berkowitz, S. J., & Horng, S. (2019). MIMIC-CXR-JPG, a large publicly available database of labeled chest radiographs. arXiv:1901.07042. https://doi.org/10.1109/CVPR.2019.00851
